curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8260-1-1.pdf and 8260-1-2.pdf (the tractor; book 2 page 18 shows its functions); 8260-1-3.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: Turning the red knob at the back turns the worm under the tractor, which turns the 8 tooth gear on the loader arms' axle: the arms and the bucket on them rise and lower.
functions.source: book: 2 page 18 (arrows: knob turning, arms rising); 1 steps 7-10 (axle, worm, red knob); 2 steps 25-30 (arms and bucket)

functions.does: The bucket tips forward and back by hand on its click hinge at the arms' ends, holding where it's left.
functions.source: book: 2 page 18 (curved arrow at the bucket); 2 step 29 (click hinge and bucket)
functions.note: the click hinge holds the bucket in steps, by friction

functions.does: The wheels roll freely: the two big rear wheels together on their 8-long axle, the two small front wheels each on its own pin. There's no steering.
The steering wheel turns on its axle in the cab, but steers nothing: the front wheels sit on fixed pins.
functions.source: book: 2 step 20 (steering wheel); inferred: that nothing joins it to the front wheels
